summary_en: The study tests LY4052031, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4, in people with advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer or other solid tumors. It is given intravenously (into a vein), and some arms also receive pembrolizumab by the same route; the study lasts up to about 4 years, and how often doses are given is not stated. The study looks at whether the drug is safe, tolerable and effective, the main outcome measure is not stated in the record, and it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa LY4052031, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a Nectin-4, en personas con cáncer urotelial avanzado o metastásico u otros tumores sólidos. El medicamento se administra por vía intravenosa, y algunos grupos también reciben pembrolizumab por la misma vía; el estudio dura hasta aproximadamente 4 años, y la frecuencia de las dosis no está indicada. El estudio busca saber si el fármaco es seguro, tolerable y eficaz; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada en el registro, y es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with one of the listed advanced or metastatic solid tumors.
Prior treatment rules differ by group; some need prior standard therapy, and one group must be treatment-naive for urothelial cancer.
Measurable disease required under RECIST 1.1 criteria.
Adequate archival tumor tissue or a screening biopsy if allowed.
not_for: Known or suspected uncontrolled brain metastases.
Corneal keratopathy, keratitis, or history of corneal transplant.
Serious unresolved toxicity from prior therapy, significant cardiovascular disease, or recent thromboembolic event or bleeding disorder.
QTcF of 470 ms or higher, history of pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
